def eyes(f):
    e=sorted([(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='S'])
    return e
def term():
    r=last_action_result
    return {k:r[k] for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete') if r.get(k)}
def timer(f):
    return sum(n['pixels'] for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='W')
print("current:",eyes(current_frame),"timer",timer(current_frame))
for a,rev in [('UP','DOWN'),('DOWN','UP'),('LEFT','RIGHT'),('RIGHT','LEFT')]:
    s0=eyes(current_frame)
    action([a]); t=term(); s1=eyes(current_frame)
    print(f"{a}: {s0} -> {s1}  {t if t else ''}")
    if t: break
    if s1!=s0:
        action([rev]); s2=eyes(current_frame)
        print(f"  {rev} back: {s2}  (match={s2==s0})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def eyes(f):
    e=sorted([(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='S'])
    return e
def term():
    r=last_action_result
    return {k:r[k] for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete') if r.get(k)}
def timer(f):
    return sum(n['pixels'] for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='W')
print("current:",eyes(current_frame),"timer",timer(current_frame))
for a,rev in [('UP','DOWN'),('DOWN','UP'),('LEFT','RIGHT'),('RIGHT','LEFT')]:
    s0=eyes(current_frame)
    action([a]); t=term(); s1=eyes(current_frame)
    print(f"{a}: {s0} -> {s1}  {t if t else ''}")
    if t: break
    if s1!=s0:
        action([rev]); s2=eyes(current_frame)
        print(f"  {rev} back: {s2}  (match={s2==s0})")
